intent: Hold the open state of one edge-anchored panel and tie its trigger to that panel.
typical_uses: A focused task or form in a panel that slides in from one edge of the viewport over the page
The details of a record opened from a list, with the list staying in place behind the panel

dont_use_when.situation: A short prompt or form shown centered over the page
A confirmation the user must answer before continuing, such as before a destructive action
An edge panel the user drags or swipes to dismiss
A list of actions anchored to a trigger

invariants.text: `open` and `defaultOpen` are both accepted; `defaultOpen` seeds the initial state and is ignored afterwards, and when `open` is given it wins and the component follows it on every render.

With `modal` at its default `true`, focus is trapped in the panel, page scroll is locked and presses outside the panel reach nothing on the page; `'trap-focus'` traps focus without locking page scroll or adding the primitive's own blocking layer; `false` traps no focus, locks no scroll and adds no blocking layer. In every mode the visible backdrop SheetContent renders stays, covering the page and catching presses on it, unless `showBackdrop={false}`.

Escape and a press outside the panel close the sheet, reporting the reason to `onOpenChange`; with nested dialogs open, only the topmost one closes. `disablePointerDismissal` keeps an outside press from closing it, and for a non-modal sheet also keeps focus moving out from closing it.

anti_patterns.do_instead: Update the state `open` reads from inside `onOpenChange`; a controlled sheet closes only when `open` turns false, so Escape, an outside press and every close button otherwise leave it open

children.states: children is the root's content, either React nodes or a function of the active trigger's payload that returns them
children.because: `React.ReactNode | PayloadChildRenderFunction<Payload>` - the function form receives `{ payload }` from whichever trigger opened the sheet. The compiler emits one JSON type per property, and a function has no JSON Schema representation.

modal.states: modal is true, false or the string 'trap-focus'
modal.because: `boolean | 'trap-focus'` - the compiler emits one JSON type per property, so a boolean-or-string union is left unasserted.

onOpenChange.states: onOpenChange is a callback called with the next open state and event details, not a value
onOpenChange.because: `(open: boolean, eventDetails) => void`; the second argument carries Base UI's change-event details, including the reason (a trigger press, an outside press, Escape, a close press, focus moving out or an imperative action). No JSON Schema type covers a function.

onOpenChangeComplete.states: onOpenChangeComplete is a callback called with the open state once the open or close animation has finished
onOpenChangeComplete.because: `(open: boolean) => void` - a function, which no JSON Schema type covers.

actionsRef.states: actionsRef is a ref the root fills with imperative `close` and `unmount` actions
actionsRef.because: `React.RefObject<DialogRootActions | null>` - a ref object holding functions, which no JSON Schema type covers.

handle.states: handle is an opaque object from the primitive's Dialog.createHandle(), shared with a trigger placed outside this root
handle.because: `DialogHandle<Payload>` is a class instance holding the sheet's store, not data; the kit re-exports no createHandle, so a caller imports it from the primitive.

triggerId.states: triggerId is the id of the trigger a controlled sheet is open for, or null
triggerId.because: `string | null` - the compiler emits one JSON type per property, so a string-or-null union is left unasserted.

defaultTriggerId.states: defaultTriggerId is the id of the trigger an initially open sheet is open for, or null
defaultTriggerId.because: `string | null` - the compiler emits one JSON type per property, so a string-or-null union is left unasserted.

good.title: A sheet opened by a kit Button, with a title and footer actions
good.code:
<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>Edit profile</SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent>
    <SheetHeader>
      <SheetTitle>Edit profile</SheetTitle>
      <SheetDescription>Changes apply when you save.</SheetDescription>
    </SheetHeader>
    <SheetFooter>
      <SheetClose render={<Button variant="outline" />}>Cancel</SheetClose>
      <Button onClick={save}>Save</Button>
    </SheetFooter>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>

bad.title: A made-up prop for the edge on the root
bad.why: The root takes no edge; `side` is SheetContent's prop, so the panel still opens from the right.
